description: Home the printer axes (move to origin position)

axes.description: Axes to home, space-separated. Examples: "X Y Z" (all), "X Y" (XY only), "Z" (Z only)

macros.description: Predefined macro names, sent as one G-code block in this order. Either gcode, macro, macros, or snippet_id is required.

snippet_id.description: ID of a gcode snippet to send. Either gcode, macro, macros, or snippet_id is required.

name: home_printer
